name: Inpixon
label: Indoor positioning
summary: Indoor positioning app that measures the real-time distance between BLE devices, with a Flutter UI and a native Kotlin BLE plugin.
description: Indoor positioning app for Inpixon, built at Vivasoft from 2023 to 2024. I started the Flutter app, delivering the core UI and a native Android (Kotlin) BLE communication layer, integrated as a Flutter plugin, for real-time device communication and distance measurement.
contributions: Native Android (Kotlin) BLE communication layer integrated as a Flutter plugin.
